entries.summaryZh: 1161年11月，金帝完颜亮率军南下，试图自采石矶（今安徽马鞍山）渡过长江攻宋。南宋文臣虞允文临时督师，组织水军以车船和霹雳炮迎战，金军渡江失败，金朝内部随即发生兵变，完颜亮被部下所杀。此役保住了南宋的江淮防线，宋金南北对峙的格局得以延续。
entries.summaryEn: In November 1161 the Jin emperor Wanyan Liang tried to cross the Yangtze at Caishi, near modern Ma'anshan, to conquer the Southern Song. Yu Yunwen, a civil official, took command of the defence and led paddle-wheel warships carrying trebuchets and gunpowder bombs against the Jin fleet. The crossing failed, and Wanyan Liang was killed by his own officers soon afterwards.
entries.significanceZh: 采石之战阻止了金军渡江，是南宋立国后最重要的一次防御胜利，也加速了金朝内部的政权更替。
entries.significanceEn: The battle stopped the Jin crossing, stands as the Southern Song's most important defensive victory and hastened the regime change at the Jin court.
entries.notesZh: 中文维基以绍兴三十一年十一月系年，英文维基给出11月26日至27日；本条只保留年份精度，且专指1161年宋金之战。
entries.notesEn: Chinese Wikipedia dates the fighting to the eleventh month of the thirty-first Shaoxing year while English Wikipedia gives 26-27 November; the entry keeps year precision and refers to the 1161 Jin-Song battle only.

entries.summaryZh: 1180年，源赖朝与武田信义等源氏势力在骏河国富士川迎战平维盛率领的平家追讨军。平家军误把水鸟惊飞当作夜袭，阵脚大乱，几乎未经交战便自行溃散，平维盛只身逃回京都。此役是源平合战初期的重要转折，源氏由此在关东站稳脚跟，也为日后进军京都打开了局面。
entries.summaryEn: In 1180, at the Fuji River in Suruga Province, the Minamoto forces of Yoritomo and Takeda Nobuyoshi faced a punitive army of the Taira led by Taira no Koremori. Startled by a flight of waterfowl, the Taira camp panicked and scattered without a real engagement; Koremori fled back to Kyoto.
entries.significanceZh: 富士川之战几乎未经激战便击溃平家追讨军，使源赖朝得以稳固关东根据地，成为源平合战的关键开端。
entries.significanceEn: The near-bloodless collapse of the Taira punitive force let Yoritomo consolidate his Kanto base and opened the Genpei War in earnest.
entries.notesZh: 中文维基系于治承四年十月二十日（1180年11月9日），英文维基只记1180年；本条保留年份精度，不折算月日。
entries.notesEn: Chinese Wikipedia dates the battle to the twentieth day of the tenth month of Jisho 4 (9 November 1180) while English Wikipedia records only 1180; the entry keeps year precision.

entries.summaryZh: 1805年10月14日，拿破仑大军团第六军在内伊元帅指挥下强攻乌尔姆以北的埃尔兴根，击溃约翰·里施统率的奥地利军。奥军被迫退入乌尔姆，随即被法军合围，数周后投降，乌尔姆战役以法军大胜告终。此役是拿破仑当年对奥作战的关键一环。
entries.summaryEn: On 14 October 1805 Michel Ney's VI Corps stormed the Elchingen bridge north of Ulm and routed the Austrian corps of Johann Sigismund Riesch. The beaten Austrians fell back into Ulm, where Napoleon's army encircled them; the garrison surrendered weeks later, closing the Ulm campaign.
entries.significanceZh: 埃尔兴根之战完成了对乌尔姆的合围，直接促成奥军主力投降，是拿破仑1805年对奥战争的决定性步骤之一。
entries.significanceEn: It completed the encirclement of Ulm and forced the surrender of the main Austrian army, deciding Napoleon's 1805 campaign against Austria.
entries.notesZh: 本条采用中英文维基一致的1805年10月14日，只保留年份精度；1800年另有史塔卡赫之战，勿与之混淆。
entries.notesEn: Both Wikipedia articles give 14 October 1805 and the entry keeps year precision; it is not the separate Battle of Stockach of 1800.

entries.summaryZh: 1860年9月21日，第二次鸦片战争期间，僧格林沁统率的清军主力——蒙古骑兵与京畿八旗绿营——在通州八里桥迎战英法联军。联军凭借线膛枪炮击溃清军骑兵，僧格林沁部损失惨重。咸丰帝随即逃往承德，联军进逼北京，清朝被迫签订《北京条约》。
entries.summaryEn: On 21 September 1860, during the Second Opium War, Qing forces under Sengge Rinchen, mainly Mongol cavalry and Beijing garrison troops, met the Anglo-French army at Baliqiao near Tongzhou. Rifled artillery broke the cavalry; the emperor fled to Chengde, the allies entered Beijing and the Qing court signed the Convention of Beijing.
entries.significanceZh: 八里桥之战摧毁了清军最精锐的骑兵主力，为英法联军攻入北京、迫使清朝签订《北京条约》扫清了道路。
entries.significanceEn: The destruction of the Qing cavalry opened Beijing to the Anglo-French force and forced the treaty that ended the Second Opium War.
entries.notesZh: 双方兵力与伤亡数字各家记载不一，本条不采信单一数字，只保留年份精度。
entries.notesEn: Troop and casualty figures differ between accounts, so no single set of numbers is adopted and the entry keeps year precision.

entries.summaryZh: 489年8月28日，东哥特国王狄奥多里克大帝率军在阿奎莱亚附近的伊松提乌斯河畔迎战奥多亚塞，争夺意大利的统治权。狄奥多里克获胜，奥多亚塞退往维罗纳，双方随后又多次交锋。此役是狄奥多里克征服意大利的开端，奥多亚塞在意大利十余年的统治由此动摇。
entries.summaryEn: On 28 August 489 Theodoric the Great, king of the Ostrogoths, defeated Odoacer's army on the banks of the Isontius river near Aquileia in the opening campaign for Italy. Odoacer withdrew towards Verona, where the two sides fought again later that year, beginning the war that ended his rule.
entries.significanceZh: 伊松佐河之战是狄奥多里克征服意大利的第一场胜利，开启了东哥特王国取代奥多亚塞统治的进程。
entries.significanceEn: It was Theodoric's first victory in the conquest of Italy and began the Ostrogothic replacement of Odoacer's rule.
entries.notesZh: 此役与一战期间的十二次伊松佐河战役同名而非同一事件，本条专指489年之战；原文所述伊松提乌斯河并非意大利语的伊松佐河。
entries.notesEn: This is the battle of 489, not the twelve First World War battles of the Isonzo; the river the sources call Isontius is not the Italian Isonzo.

entries.summaryZh: 1184年3月4日，源义仲在宇治川、六条河原连败后率残部退往北陆，行至近江国粟津时遭源范赖、源义经所部甲斐源氏军追击。义仲战马陷入水田，中箭阵亡，今井兼平随之自尽，木曾源氏势力覆灭。此役终结了源氏内部的权力争夺，为源赖朝统一源氏铺平道路。
entries.summaryEn: On 4 March 1184 Minamoto no Yoshinaka, beaten at the Uji and Rokujo rivers, retreated north and was caught at Awazu in Omi Province by the armies of his cousins Noriyori and Yoshitsune. His horse mired in a paddy field, Yoshinaka was shot dead and his retainer Imai Kanehira killed himself.
entries.significanceZh: 粟津之战消灭了源义仲势力，结束了源氏内讧，源赖朝由此独占举兵讨平的领导权。
entries.significanceEn: Awazu destroyed Yoshinaka's faction and left Yoritomo as the undisputed leader of the Minamoto rising against the Taira.
entries.notesZh: 中文维基以寿永三年正月二十（1184年3月4日）系日，英文维基未记月日；本条只保留年份精度。
entries.notesEn: Chinese Wikipedia dates the battle to 4 March 1184 while English Wikipedia gives no day; the entry keeps year precision.

entries.summaryZh: 1844年8月14日，法国元帅比若率军在摩洛哥伊斯利河畔击败苏丹阿卜杜勒-拉赫曼之子穆罕默德王子统率的摩洛哥军队。法国意在迫使摩洛哥停止支持阿尔及利亚抵抗领袖阿卜杜·卡迪尔，战前并未宣战。战后双方签约，摩洛哥承诺放弃对卡迪尔的支持。
entries.summaryEn: On 14 August 1844 French forces under Marshal Bugeaud routed a larger but poorly organised Moroccan army commanded by Muhammad, son of Sultan Abd al-Rahman, near the Isly River. France acted without a declaration of war to end Moroccan support for the Algerian resistance leader Abd el-Kader, and the defeat forced Morocco to negotiate.
entries.significanceZh: 伊斯利之战迫使摩洛哥放弃对阿卜杜·卡迪尔的支持，加速了法国对阿尔及利亚的征服，并确立了法摩之间的不平等关系。
entries.significanceEn: The battle forced Morocco to drop Abd el-Kader, accelerated the French conquest of Algeria and set the terms of French dominance over Morocco.
entries.notesZh: 摩洛哥方面的兵力与伤亡数字各家统计差距很大，本条不采信具体数字，只保留年份精度。
entries.notesEn: Moroccan troop and casualty estimates vary widely between accounts, so no figure is adopted and the entry keeps year precision.

entries.summaryZh: 1879年3月29日，祖鲁战争期间，祖鲁军队在坎布拉攻击英军营地，此前一天他们刚击溃英军骑马部队。英军已构筑车阵与工事，以密集火力击退祖鲁军的反复冲击，祖鲁方面阵亡约两千人，英军损失二十九人。祖鲁王国此后再无进攻能力，战争胜负就此逆转。
entries.summaryEn: On 29 March 1879, during the Anglo-Zulu War, a Zulu army attacked the British camp at Kambula a day after routing its mounted patrol. The entrenched British square broke the assault with concentrated fire, killing roughly two thousand warriors for the loss of twenty-nine soldiers, and Zulu confidence never recovered.
entries.significanceZh: 坎布拉战役是祖鲁战争的转折点，祖鲁王国主力在此战后丧失进攻能力，同年七月即告覆亡。
entries.significanceEn: It was the turning point of the Anglo-Zulu War: the Zulu army lost its offensive power and the kingdom fell that July.
entries.notesZh: 英文维基给出3月29日与双方伤亡估计，中文维基只记年份和大略战果；本条保留年份精度，伤亡数字标注为估计值。
entries.notesEn: English Wikipedia gives 29 March and casualty estimates while Chinese Wikipedia records only the year and the rough outcome; the entry keeps year precision and marks the figures as estimates.

entries.summaryZh: 公元前632年，晋文公率晋军联合齐、秦、宋等国，在城濮（今山东鄄城一带）与楚国令尹子玉统率的楚、陈、蔡联军决战。晋军以退避三舍诱敌、集中兵力各个击破，楚军大败。战后晋文公在践土会盟诸侯，确立霸主地位，楚国北进受挫，此战也被视为春秋时期规模最大的会战之一。
entries.summaryEn: In 632 BCE the army of Jin under Duke Wen, allied with Qi, Qin and Song, defeated the forces of Chu and its allies at Chengpu in present-day Shandong. Jin troops feigned retreat, split the Chu lines and broke them; the victory let Duke Wen convene the lords at Jiantu and be recognised as hegemon.
entries.significanceZh: 城濮之战确立了晋文公的霸主地位，奠定了春秋中期晋楚长期争霸的格局。
entries.significanceEn: Chengpu made Duke Wen hegemon and set the pattern of Jin-Chu rivalry that dominated the middle Spring and Autumn period.
entries.notesZh: 维基数据P585记为ISO -631年，即民用纪年的公元前632年（本项目无0年），本条采用-632；战役地点与月日史载不一。
entries.notesEn: Wikidata P585 records ISO -631, which is 632 BCE in the civil convention used here (no year zero), so the entry uses -632; the site and date are disputed in the sources.

entries.summaryZh: 2010年3月26日，韩国海军浦项级护卫舰天安号在黄海白翎岛附近巡逻时爆炸沉没，舰上104名官兵中46人死亡。韩国主导的多国调查团认定该舰遭朝鲜潜艇发射的鱼雷击沉，朝鲜否认。联合国安理会谴责袭击但未指明责任方，事件使朝鲜半岛局势急剧紧张。
entries.summaryEn: On 26 March 2010 the South Korean corvette Cheonan sank after an explosion while patrolling near Baengnyeong Island in the Yellow Sea, killing 46 of its 104 crew. A South Korean-led international investigation concluded that a North Korean torpedo sank the ship; North Korea denied involvement and the UN Security Council condemned the attack without naming the attacker.
entries.significanceZh: 天安号事件是冷战后朝鲜半岛最严重的军事危机之一，导致韩国对朝制裁与南北关系全面冻结。
entries.significanceEn: The sinking became one of the gravest Korean Peninsula crises since the Cold War, triggering South Korean sanctions and a freeze in inter-Korean relations.
entries.notesZh: 沉没原因仍有争议，朝鲜与部分韩国研究者提出其他解释；本条只记官方调查结论与争议事实，保留年份精度。
entries.notesEn: The cause remains disputed, with North Korea and some South Korean researchers offering other explanations; the entry records the official finding and the dispute at year precision.
